name: patchwork-compat-fixes
title: Patchwork — Cross-Mod Compatibility Fixes
author: Alvin
description: Fifteen cross-mod compatibility fixes that make big modpacks behave like one mod: 5Dim labs accept all science packs; 5Dim/mini/Advanced furnaces smelt everything incl. K2 coke; sniper bullets fly as far as sniper turrets see; 5Dim solar/accumulator/locomotive/underground-reach/turret/reactor/heat-exchanger tiers follow base rebalances; Hovercrafts fuel fallback; spidertron grid size sync; productivity on Advanced Furnaces wood-to-coal; all 1x1 loaders upgrade-planner interchangeable and circuit-connectable; smart belt dragging (auto-undergrounds) enabled for belts missing their underground pairing; AutoDeconstruct no longer removes drill-output chests that feed loader chains. Every fix silently disables itself when its target mods are not installed.
